lines: The time that was bound to come has arrived
When that moment comes, don't be sad, darling
It's about time we had
a talk like this — we've come that far, haven't we
Facing a future worth fearing
Don't be too badly frightened, darling
Though the one who said that
is scared beyond bearing herself
Goodbye draws steadily closer, before we know it
The fallen leaves, the cicadas facing the sky
lived in the same world we do, just the same way
Tonight again, the direction the bell rings from
lies hushed, like after a festival
We rush, trying to get as far away as we can
In a town of people just like us, with our empty chests, now
we press our heartbeats harder and race headlong toward the future
So that the hour of parting
won't even catch the corner of our eyes
as if telling ourselves so
Before we know it, somewhere
starts aching without pause, and we end up worn out
The cakes with more and more candles
leave less and less we can finish eating
After blowing them out, wrapped in the dark,
this happiness will someday end — it's too much
I nearly cling to anyone at all,
crying that it's unfair
Goodbye draws steadily closer, before we know it
The school building, the station, they grow old
We're the same — I know that perfectly well
Tonight again, in the living room with no lights on
I run into a memory unawares and shoulder the helplessness
I drain the water, and the glass lies in the sink
In our empty chests, in the room of another who can't sleep, now
a life beaded with droplets ends its day
With no explanation, just as it is
the world turns the next page, and I falter
Tonight again, the direction the bell rings from
lies hushed, like after a festival
We pray, as if to thin out the urgency
In a town of people just like us, with our empty arms, now
I pull you close without a moment's hesitation
Until the hour of parting
so that not a single moment goes by unloved
as if telling ourselves so
The time that was bound to come has arrived
When that moment comes, don't be sad, darling
It's morning already, isn't it
At last I feel like I can sleep, just a little
